title: Digital Skills Bootcamp
description: Build the everyday digital skills employers expect, from spreadsheets and email to online collaboration tools.
schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM
eligibility: Access to a laptop or computer lab
outcomes: Confident use of spreadsheets, email and collaboration tools

title: Data Analytics Foundations
description: Learn to collect, clean and present data so you can answer real business questions with confidence.
schedule: Mondays and Wednesdays, 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM
eligibility: Completed the Digital Skills Bootcamp or an equivalent assessment
outcomes: A data dashboard for your portfolio

title: CV and Interview Workshop
description: A hands-on session on writing a strong CV and handling common interview questions, with live feedback from recruiters.
eligibility: Bring a draft CV if you have one

title: Web Development Starter Workshop
description: Build and publish your first simple website over one weekend, no experience needed.
schedule: Saturday and Sunday, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM

title: Careers in Tech Webinar
description: Hear from professionals working in technology about the roles that exist and how they got started.
outcomes: Clear picture of entry-level tech roles
Chance to ask professionals your questions

title: Starting Your First Business
description: A four-week webinar series on testing an idea, pricing, and finding your first customers.
eligibility: A business idea, even an early one

title: Partner Internship Placement
description: A twelve-week placement with an Excelerate partner organisation, with a mentor to support you throughout.
schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, hybrid
eligibility: Completed at least one Excelerate program
Up-to-date CV uploaded to your profile
outcomes: Reference letter from your host organisation

title: Leadership, Communication and Professional Presentation Skills Masterclass for Emerging Young Professionals
description: This masterclass covers leading small teams, communicating clearly in writing and in meetings, giving confident presentations, and handling feedback. Each session combines short lessons with group practice, and you will present a short talk to a panel at the end of the program.
eligibility: Completed at least one Excelerate program
outcomes: A recorded presentation for your portfolio
